newsitem.title: USA: CSCE cocoa called to open $5 to $10 higher.
newsitem.headline: CSCE cocoa called to open $5 to $10 higher.

text.p: CSCE cocoa futures were called to open $5 to $10 higher Friday on the heels of a strong performance in London overnight, traders said.
LIFFE cocoa futures were higher early Friday, lifted by industry-related buying, with July cocoa up 13 stg at the midday break at 1,045 stg a tonne and September 12 stg higher at 1,060 stg.
Thursday, New York cocoa futures rallied to eight-week highs, boosted by technically driven speculative buying."
July ended up $32 at $1,498 a tonne after trading from $1,502 to $1,467. Second-month September settled up the same at $1,528, while the back months gained $27 to $34.
On the charts, traders pegged July resistance at $1,522 to $1,525, followed by $1,540. They put support at $1,490. ((--Patricia Avidan, New York Commodity Desk 212 859 1640))
